headline: Record operating income; full-year EPS guide raised
summary_short: Revenue rose 4.4% to $4,236M, operating income hit a record $1,177M and GAAP EPS grew 6.8% to $3.00. ITW raised 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to $11.45-$11.55.
summary_long: Organic growth was 3.8%, led by 6.0% in North America; a tornado at two Welding plants cost about $40M of revenue, mostly offset in profit by insurance. Enterprise initiatives added 130bp to operating margin and price actions more than offset raw material costs. Free cash flow was 100% of net income and the company repurchased $187M of stock. It raised its dividend 7%, to $6.88 annualized. Revenue growth guidance is now 4.5%-5.5% with organic growth of 3%-4% reaffirmed.
confidence_notes: Free cash flow is a non-GAAP measure. Excluding the Welding tornado, organic growth would have been about 5%, per the release.

drivers.explanation: Enterprise initiatives contributed 130bp, and price increases and other actions more than offset rising raw material costs.
Organic growth of 3.8%, plus 0.3% from currency and 0.3% from an acquisition; a late-July tornado at two Welding facilities reduced revenue by about $40M.
CEO points to accelerating demand in capex-related segments Welding and Test & Measurement and Electronics, and more revenue contribution from Customer-Back Innovation.
